description:
Job Responsibilities
 • You will performs systems analysis and identify application solutions for a wide range of computer applications and operational issues, focusing on medium to large systems. 
 • You will works cooperatively with the Business Analysis Team to determine end user goals, objectives, business needs, requirements and to recommend the most efficient and economical way to meet those needs with appropriate business applications. 
 • You will applies a strong knowledge of application development techniques and tools to design, develop, test and implement a wide range of application solutions for internal and external clients.
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


 Job Requirements
 

 • Must be strong with RPG programming
 

 • Must have experience with IBM AS/400
 

 • Must be strong with SQL
 

 • Nice to have experience with DB2
 

 Job Key Words
 

 • AS400, RPG, SQL, DB2 

 Please send your application online under ettaingroup.com and contact Antonette Tubera at 972.421.4687 
 

 ettain group’s goal is to match great people with great opportunities. Our commitment is to provide an unparalleled experience for you. Whether you are looking for a technology consulting project or a full-time IT job, ettain group can help you find the job that aligns with your career goals
 

 Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, and with offices in Atlanta, Dallas, Jacksonville, Nashville, Raleigh, Washington D.C., and Winston-Salem, ettain group has experienced consultants working across North America. ettain group’s team of more than 150 full-time employees and over 800 consultants delivers innovative and effective technology and business solutions to a variety of industries including healthcare, financial services, retail and emerging industries.
